Destinia for Nintendo Switch -- 1.0.0

Installation:
  1. Copy destinia.nro to      sdmc:/switch/destinia/destinia.nro
  2. Copy your own APK to      sdmc:/switch/destinia/DESTINIA_v1_06.apk
     (Destinia v1.06 for Android by Gamevil. The game is read from it at runtime; nothing from the game is
      included in this package. The game library inside the APK is checked by SHA-256, so other versions
      are refused with a message; re-signed copies of v1.06 work.)

Home Menu Forwarder / Shortcut (NSP / NSZ):
  To launch Destinia directly from the Nintendo Switch Home Menu with full RAM (~3.2 GB+, Title Override mode)
  instead of Applet mode (~400 MB):
  - Install "Destinia [0100D3571A000000] [v0].nsp" (or .nsz) using DBI, Tinfoil, TinWoo, or Sphaira ("Install Forwarder").
  - Launch Destinia directly from your Home Menu!
  - When updating destinia in the future, just replace destinia.nro on your SD card; you never need to reinstall the forwarder.

Controls (Console Action-RPG HUD):
  Left stick / D-pad: move hero / navigate in menus
  Touchscreen:        native touch input supported (tap buttons/menus, drag left half to walk)
  A                   confirm / attack / talk
  B                   cancel / character menu in field
  Minus (-)           open Mini Map
  Plus (+)            system menu (Save / Options)
  Right stick         move on-screen pointer
  RS (R3 click)       save screenshot to shots/shot_NNNN.ppm
  HOME                sleep / suspend / resume (audio and vibration safely cut off)

Quick Slots & 2-Page Hotbar (Hold L modifier):
  Page 1 (Normal / L released):
    ZL:               Potion / Consumable (Slot 4)
    Y:                Combat Skill 1 (Slot 0)
    X:                Combat Skill 2 (Slot 1)
    R:                Combat Skill 3 (Slot 2)
    ZR:               Combat Skill 4 (Slot 3)
  Page 2 (Holding L shoulder button):
    L + ZL:           Utility / Potion 2 (Slot 9)
    L + Y:            Combat Skill 5 (Slot 5)
    L + X:            Combat Skill 6 (Slot 6)
    L + R:            Combat Skill 7 (Slot 7)
    L + ZR:           Combat Skill 8 (Slot 8)

Vibration / HD Rumble:
  Native Nintendo Switch HD Rumble (Handheld, Joy-Con Dual, Pro Controller) and standard PC rumble.

Offline Single-Player Mode:
  The game runs in pure offline single-player mode. Network dialogs are automatically dismissed,
  and original game balance and progression are fully preserved.

Saves go to sdmc:/switch/destinia/save/.
Diagnostics / Log: sdmc:/switch/destinia/log.txt
